'''Sellasas''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it hosted an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In the wake of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] subjected the world to a protracted [[Siege of Sellasas|siege]], and Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] all but one member of a local [[Srrors'tok]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Tyionsis Cex's family|family]] that was caught in the middle of the fighting. The events on Sellasas led the last surviving member of the family, [[Tyionsis Cex]], who had fought against the Rebels, to become a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in service to the Empire.

==Description==
Sellasas was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GG10" /> located in the [[Sellasas system/Legends|Sellasas system]], a part of the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:TyionsisCex-GG10.png|thumb|right|300px|On Sellasas, the Srrors'tok Tyionsis Cex (pictured) witnessed his entire family being killed by Rebel Alliance soldiers.]]
At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|VI}}, which corresponds to a [[Time/Legends|time]] period which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' sets between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. ''Galaxy Guide 10'' also establishes that the [[Siege of Sellasas|siege]] on Sellasas took place at least two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the sourcebook's setting and also after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the latter of which occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] per ''The New Essential Chronology''. Therefore, the siege must have occurred at some point between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> in the wake of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched attacks on poorly defended outposts of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with a seven-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long relentless [[Siege of Sellasas|siege]] taking place on Sellasas. The [[Unidentified Rebel Alliance commander (Sellasas)|Alliance commander]] leading the assault set as the operation's goal the elimination of the Imperial presence on the world even at the expense of massive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]].<ref name="GG10" />

During the siege, members of a local [[Srrors'tok]] [[Tyionsis Cex's family|family]] of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], having been caught in the middle of the fighting, were killed one by one until only [[Tyionsis Cex]] remained alive. He began fighting back against the Rebels and was eventually rescued and joined by [[Amara Jedselk]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of the [[Planetary Governor/Legends|planetary governor]] [[Jedselk]] and the second-in-command of the local [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. The two subsequently evaded capture for several [[Local day/Legends|days]].<ref name="GG10" />

Although the Alliance prevailed in the siege,<ref name="TEA" /> Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] eventually withdrew from Sellasas, with an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] relief force arriving there under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kedler]]. Around that time, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] Jedselk was promoted to the governorship of [[Dolla/Legends|Dolla]], an important [[Navy/Legends|naval]] staging area<ref name="GG10" /> in the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]],<ref name="EAOC Dolla">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dolla system/Legends|Dolla system]]</ref> and Cex, deeply affected by his loss on Sellasas, eventually became an Imperial [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in Jedselk's service.<ref name="GG10" />

==Inhabitants==
By the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, it was ruled by Imperial governor Jedselk and was home to an Imperial [[Army/Legends|army]] garrison as well as a family of merchants of the<ref name="GG10" /> offworld<ref name="AlienEncounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Srrors'tok [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sellasas was first mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sellasas [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;the name of which it misspelled as "Selasas"&mdash;and therefore Sellasas itself, in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
